candidates.change_summary: Change the body to always return true instead of checking approvedLoggers.
Change the body to always return false instead of checking approvedLoggers.
Negate the return value by returning !approvedLoggers[_caller].
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from setApprovedLogger, allowing anyone to change approvedLoggers entries.
Replace approvedLoggers[_logger] = _status with a no-op (do nothing), causing the mapping value to never change.
Delete the entire onlyOwner modifier body requirement, making every onlyOwner-guarded function accessible to anyone.
Replace approvedLoggers[_logger] with approvedLoggers[msg.sender], so the status is set for the caller instead of the supplied address.
Insert a reversal of _status before assignment, so the stored value is the opposite of what was passed.
Restrict setting only when _status is true, making it impossible to revoke an approved logger.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from setApprovedLogger so anyone can call it.
Change the onlyOwner modifier's require to always pass by making the condition true.
Remove the require statement from onlyOwner so the modifier performs no access check.
Replace `if (!approvedToLog(msg.sender)) return false;` with `if (!approvedToLog(msg.sender)) return true;` to invert the failure-case return value.
Replace `return true;` after the emit with `return false;` so that success returns false instead of true.
Delete the `if (!approvedToLog(msg.sender)) return false;` guard, causing unapproved callers to succeed (emit event and return true).
Replace 'if (!approvedToLog(msg.sender)) return false;' with 'if (!approvedToLog(msg.sender)) return true;'
Replace 'return true;' at end of function with 'return false;'
Delete the entire approval check 'if (!approvedToLog(msg.sender)) return false;'
